cases.query: EVALUATE ROW("a", DATE(10000, 1, 1))
EVALUATE ROW("a", DATEVALUE("2024-03-05"), "b", DATEVALUE("3/5/2024"), "c", DATEVALUE("5 March 2024"), "d", DATEVALUE("March 5, 2024"), "e", DATEVALUE("2024-03-05 14:00"), "f", DATEVALUE(BLANK()))
EVALUATE ROW("a", DATEVALUE("not a date"))
EVALUATE ROW("a", TIMEVALUE("2:30 PM"), "b", TIMEVALUE("14:30:15"), "c", TIMEVALUE("2024-03-05 06:00:00"), "d", TIMEVALUE(BLANK()))

EVALUATE ROW("y", YEAR(DATE(2024, 3, 5)), "m", MONTH(DATE(2024, 3, 5)), "d", DAY(DATE(2024, 3, 5)), "q", QUARTER(DATE(2024, 5, 1)), "q4", QUARTER(DATE(2024, 12, 31)), "ys", YEAR("2024-03-05"), "yb", YEAR(BLANK()), "mb", MONTH(BLANK()), "db", DAY(BLANK()))

EVALUATE ROW("h", HOUR(DATE(2024, 3, 5) + TIME(14, 30, 15)), "mi", MINUTE(DATE(2024, 3, 5) + TIME(14, 30, 15)), "s", SECOND(DATE(2024, 3, 5) + TIME(14, 30, 15)), "h0", HOUR(DATE(2024, 3, 5)), "hb", HOUR(BLANK()), "hn", HOUR(0.75), "s59", SECOND(TIME(0, 0, 59)))
EVALUATE ROW("a", YEAR(45000), "b", MONTH(45000), "c", DAY(1), "d", YEAR(0), "e", YEAR(-1))

EVALUATE ROW("a", WEEKDAY(DATE(2024, 1, 1)), "b", WEEKDAY(DATE(2024, 1, 1), 2), "c", WEEKDAY(DATE(2024, 1, 1), 3), "d", WEEKDAY(DATE(2024, 1, 7)), "e", WEEKDAY(DATE(2024, 1, 7), 2), "f", WEEKDAY(DATE(2024, 1, 3), 12), "g", WEEKDAY(DATE(2024, 1, 1), 11), "h", WEEKDAY(DATE(2024, 1, 1), 17), "i", WEEKDAY(DATE(2024, 1, 7), 3))
EVALUATE ROW("a", WEEKDAY(DATE(2024, 1, 1), 9))

EVALUATE ROW("a", WEEKNUM(DATE(2024, 1, 1)), "b", WEEKNUM(DATE(2024, 1, 6)), "c", WEEKNUM(DATE(2024, 1, 7)), "d", WEEKNUM(DATE(2024, 1, 8), 2), "e", WEEKNUM(DATE(2024, 12, 31), 21), "f", WEEKNUM(DATE(2024, 12, 31)), "g", WEEKNUM(DATE(2023, 1, 1)), "h", WEEKNUM(DATE(2023, 1, 1), 2), "i", WEEKNUM(DATE(2021, 1, 3), 21))

EVALUATE ROW("a", EOMONTH(DATE(2024, 1, 15), 1), "b", EOMONTH(DATE(2024, 1, 15), -1), "c", EOMONTH(DATE(2023, 2, 1), 0), "d", EOMONTH(DATE(2024, 1, 15) + TIME(14, 0, 0), 0), "e", EOMONTH(BLANK(), 0), "f", EOMONTH(DATE(2024, 1, 31), 13))

EVALUATE ROW("a", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 31), DATE(2024, 2, 1), MONTH), "b", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 31), MONTH), "c", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 3, 1), DAY), "d", DATEDIFF(DATE(2023, 12, 31), DATE(2024, 1, 1), YEAR), "e", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 3, 31), DATE(2024, 4, 1), QUARTER), "f", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 3, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 1), DAY))

EVALUATE ROW("a", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 6), DATE(2024, 1, 7), WEEK), "b", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 6), WEEK), "c", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 14), WEEK), "d", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 7), DATE(2024, 1, 6), WEEK))

EVALUATE ROW("a", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 1) + TIME(2, 30, 0), MINUTE), "b", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 1) + TIME(0, 59, 0), DATE(2024, 1, 1) + TIME(1, 1, 0), HOUR), "c", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 1) + TIME(0, 0, 59), DATE(2024, 1, 1) + TIME(0, 1, 1), SECOND), "d", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 1) + TIME(23, 0, 0), DATE(2024, 1, 2), DAY), "e", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 1) + TIME(23, 59, 0), DATE(2024, 1, 2) + TIME(0, 1, 0), MINUTE))
EVALUATE ROW("a", DATEDIFF(BLANK(), DATE(2024, 1, 1), DAY), "b", DATEDIFF(DATE(2024, 1, 1), BLANK(), DAY))
EVALUATE ROW("a", DATEDIFF("2024-01-01", "2024-02-01", DAY))

EVALUATE ROW("a", NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 7)), "b", NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 7), 11), "c", NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 7), "0000011"), "d", NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 7), 1, {DATE(2024, 1, 3)}), "e", NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2024, 1, 7), DATE(2024, 1, 1)), "f", NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2024, 1, 6), DATE(2024, 1, 6)), "g", NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 7), 7), "h", NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 7), 2), "i", NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 7), 17))
EVALUATE ROW("a", NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 12, 31)))
EVALUATE ROW("a", NOW() > DATE(2024, 1, 1), "b", TODAY() <= NOW(), "c", TODAY() = INT(TODAY()), "d", UTCTODAY() <= UTCNOW(), "e", YEAR(TODAY()) >= 2025)

EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year], "feb", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Date'), MONTH('Date'[Date]) = 2), "wk", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Date'), WEEKDAY('Date'[Date], 2) > 5), "m", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), YEAR('Date'[Date]) = 2024)) ORDER BY 'Date'[Year]
EVALUATE ROW("a", COUNTROWS(FILTER(Sales, YEAR(Sales[ShipDate]) = 1899)), "b", COUNTROWS(FILTER(Sales, ISBLANK(Sales[ShipDate]))), "c", SUMX(Sales, DATEDIFF(Sales[OrderDate], Sales[ShipDate], DAY)))
